intended_object: The ordinary character table of the cyclic group of order 2 (Multiplicative (ZMod 2)), as an integer matrix. Rows are the trivial and sign characters; columns are the identity class and the non-trivial class, in the order fixed by cyclicClassData 2. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module documentation.
explanation: The definition unfolds to the matrix !![1, 1; 1, -1]. This is exactly the character table of C₂: the trivial character takes (1, 1) and the sign character takes (1, −1) on (identity, non-trivial element), matching the stated column order. C₂ is abelian, so every class is a singleton and every degree is 1. Hence the central characters coincide with the ordinary characters, and defining the ordinary table as the central-character table is mathematically correct. The file proves the degree/central-character relation, the orthogonality relations, and IsCharacterTableSpec for the table cast to ℂ (it is the complex character table up to a row permutation). It is a specific object, so it is not too narrow, and I found nothing in Mathlib that gives the character table as a matrix.
